title: v4 local drafts carry optional server metadata and reject v3 state
contract: v4 local persistence roundtrip preserves server identity/revision/generation and rejects v3; clear observation is vacuous after rejected v3 input.
credibleRegressionOrGap: No-op removal survives final load(null); preserve earlier metadata/version assertions. #301 changed v3 acceptance to rejection without strengthening clear observation.

title: resume reconciliation keeps equal local drafts and accepts only demonstrably newer server snapshots
contract: Equal local state wins; absent or mismatched local identity and newer server revision hydrate exact server answers and metadata.
credibleRegressionOrGap: Unconditionally prefer server overwrites equal local edits; unconditionally prefer local blocks newer/foreign server state.

title: server draft payload is versioned, partial-safe, and durable-only
contract: Wire payload includes v4 and revision, strips all ephemeral fields, retains partial durable values and opt-in catch-up.
credibleRegressionOrGap: Accidental email/consent/dailyTime persistence or dropped revision/catch-up flag; session fixtures do not include these extra fields.

title: resume token URL helpers preserve state, query, and fragments
contract: URL mutation preserves acquisition query/hash and history state across replace/push/remove.
credibleRegressionOrGap: Replacing query wholesale loses attribution; history overwrite breaks back navigation. Fake history captures exact real helper delivery.

title: server draft responses normalize flag-off, retryable, stale, and saved states
contract: Status interpreter maps 404/202/409 and exact saved metadata/token receipt.
credibleRegressionOrGap: Treating 202 as failed or dropping resumeToken; network-error session and created receipt are different inputs.

title: server draft session disables on 404 and strips stale tokens on 409
contract: Actual session disables on 404, latches stale on 409 and removes bearer URL token in each.
credibleRegressionOrGap: Ignoring parsed disabled/stale results or leaving stale token in URL. Parser result alone cannot prove lifecycle effects.

title: server draft session contains network failures and retries with bounded backoff
contract: Network failure containment and first three attempts are checked; asserted retry bound has insufficient observation horizon.
credibleRegressionOrGap: Changing retryCount < 2 to < 3 schedules fourth attempt at about 1500 ms, after the only 850-ms assertion; no final cap observation.

title: server draft session publishes draft identity and revision after a successful create
contract: Successful created receipt publishes exact metadata to callback and session accessor.
credibleRegressionOrGap: Removing onMetadata notification breaks durable local identity linkage; other session tests lack this callback oracle.

title: pagehide helper skips bfcache restores and keeps non-persisted unload flushing
contract: Persisted pagehide skips flush; genuine unload flushes.
credibleRegressionOrGap: Negated or constant predicate breaks bfcache lifecycle. Session tests invoke flush directly, not persisted event predicate.

title: non-persisted pagehide keepalive is the terminal server write for that heap
contract: Keepalive is terminal: post-flush queueSave causes no request; metadata reflects response and stale remains false.
credibleRegressionOrGap: Allowing subsequent queueSave after completed flush forks revision updates; in-flight ordering tests have different prefixes.

title: normal autosave first then freshest catch-up keepalive persists without latching stale
contract: In-flight normal response then freshest catch-up receipt yields two exact requests and final revision 3 without stale latch.
credibleRegressionOrGap: Drain restarts queued stale data after terminal flush, missing catch-up transport flag, or older receipt overwrites state.

title: catch-up keepalive first then older normal stale response is ignored
contract: Keepalive accepted first prevents a later older 409 from latching stale; two exact request bodies preserved.
credibleRegressionOrGap: Dropping sequence guard clears valid credential after newer write; reverse ordering is not equivalent.

title: server route and migration wire unload catch-up without weakening browser generation
contract: Parser-to-route opt-in delivery and original SQL function signature/generation/+1 bounded catch-up contract.
credibleRegressionOrGap: Source syntax is coupled, but whole callback includes independent parser and route wire delivery absent in PGlite tests. Existing SQL forward keeper is not assertion-union-equivalent.

title: server quiz drafts accept partial durable answers but reject unknown and ephemeral fields
contract: Strict partial durable schema rejects ephemeral/unknown fields, out-of-range revision, invalid enum/duplicates and unselected recurrence; accepts valid recurrence and exact text boundary.
credibleRegressionOrGap: Stripping rather than rejecting foreign keys or accepting >int32 revisions crosses persistence boundary. Client sanitizer has a different permissive contract.

title: stored v3 drafts restart cleanly while retaining their server revision seam
contract: Unversioned legacy draft restarts cleanly, v4 retains values, explicit v3 malformed envelope is rejected.
credibleRegressionOrGap: Treating explicit old version as unversioned legacy or reusing retired taxonomy. Does not itself observe database revision retention.

title: resume credentials have independent 256-bit values and cookies are signed
contract: Preserve credential length/distinctness/hash linkage, cookie roundtrip/options, query key, exchange hash comparison and canonical helper architecture; same-length invalid HMAC is untested.
credibleRegressionOrGap: Only tamper appends x, so signature-length mismatch short-circuits timingSafeEqual. Bypassing equality still satisfies all existing callback inputs.

title: landing recovery degrades to a clean snapshot when its read RPC throws
contract: Landing dependency rejection degrades to null snapshot while retaining exchange need.
credibleRegressionOrGap: Uncontained optional read failure aborts landing before analytics/render; injected rejecting dependency tests outer promise catch only, not real RPC delivery.

title: draft handlers reject disabled and cross-origin requests before database work
contract: Actual handlers return disabled404/no-store, cross-origin400 and disabled resume307 to fixed landing.
credibleRegressionOrGap: Missing exact-true/origin guards changes public response. No explicit DB-call spy: only response/ordering reachability, not independent zero-I/O proof.

title: replayed resume fallback preserves a valid stale draft cookie but clears absent or invalid cookies
contract: Replay fallback preserves valid signed stale cookie and expires absent/malformed cookies.
credibleRegressionOrGap: Always clearing valid stale cookie allows later request to look like a new create; helper is actual GET fallback.

title: migration keeps recovery state private, bounded, and atomically generation-aware
contract: Foundation private storage/grants, hashed unique credential, seven-day bound and locked generation rotation are explicit schema contracts.
credibleRegressionOrGap: Relaxing privilege, uniqueness, expiry or exchange rotation changes public storage/security contract. Forward update PGlite tests do not cover all these foundation clauses.
